controversy_hook.primary_harm_thesis: dilution of local constituent voice via concentrated ideological/outside Super PAC bundlers

vote.question: [US-CO - U.S. Senate]: John W. Hickenlooper (D) has received $55,941,391 in career campaign contributions (with $9,529,277 this cycle, alongside $12,594 in outside Super PAC support led by Democratic Messaging Project)—linked to "Outside Super PAC & Megadonor Swarm". Do you vote to formally rebuke John W. Hickenlooper for prioritizing private donor interests & failing to represent his constituents by upholding his core civic duties?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Elected stewards are entrusted with representing citizens, yet John W. Hickenlooper has amassed $55,941,391 in career contributions (with $9,529,277 this cycle, alongside $12,594 in outside Super PAC support led by Democratic Messaging Project)—prioritizing private corporate donors over constituent interests. This civic vote allows citizens to formally censure John W. Hickenlooper on the public ledger and direct 100% of the civic action escrow pool to local community restitution.

outcomes.YES_RELEASE_TO_LOCAL_CHARITIES: Directs 100% of the funds to verified local non-profits working directly on state community needs.
outcomes.NO_RELEASE_TO_COMMUNITY_COMMONS: Directs 100% of the funds to bipartisan, universal local public services (volunteer fire/EMS, veterans' care, food banks, disaster relief).
outcomes.ABSTAIN_LOG_DISSENT: Records resident feedback without moving the vote count.

futarchy_pole_mechanics.leverage_ratio_statement: Every contribution directly empowers community-led funding. Once the campaign pool reaches $5,000, an automatic 60-day countdown begins. When the 60 days expire, all funds go directly to verified local charities or essential community services—zero platform cut.

bounty_if_passed.description: Community Fund for US-CO: Delivers 100% of funds to verified, IRS-registered 501(c)(3) public charities serving CO dedicated to non-partisan civic accountability, investigative public-interest journalism, and voter legal defense. Verified local recipients: NATIONAL TRUST FOR LOCAL NEWS (US-EIN:862022385); COLORADO LEGAL SERVICES (US-EIN:840402702); NATIVE AMERICAN RIGHTS FUND (US-EIN:840611876); COLORADO IMMIGRANT RIGHTS COALITION (US-EIN:731675486); COMMUNITY FIRM (US-EIN:844867019). Once the pool hits $5,000, a 60-day timer starts. If YES wins, funds go to these charities; if NO wins, funds go to local community commons (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
bounty_if_passed.destination_criteria: All recipient organizations must be active, verified 501(c)(3) public charities registered in US-CO with clean IRS status and direct community impact. Approved charities: NATIONAL TRUST FOR LOCAL NEWS (US-EIN:862022385); COLORADO LEGAL SERVICES (US-EIN:840402702); NATIVE AMERICAN RIGHTS FUND (US-EIN:840611876); COLORADO IMMIGRANT RIGHTS COALITION (US-EIN:731675486); COMMUNITY FIRM (US-EIN:844867019).

trigger_conditions: Condition 1 (Activation): The campaign activates its 60-day countdown timer as soon as total contributions reach $5,000 USD (Base USDC).
Condition 2 (Resolution Period): The community vote runs for exactly 60 days from the moment the $5,000 threshold is reached.

Condition 3 (Payout): If YES receives 60% or more of votes, 100% of the funds are sent to the verified state non-profits; otherwise, 100% is sent to universal community services (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).

bounty_if_no_wins.description: Community Commons for US-CO: If residents decide against the restitution fund, 100% of the funds go directly to essential local community services in US-CO (Volunteer Fire/EMS, Veterans' Care, Food Banks, and Disaster Relief). Recipient non-profits: FOOD BANK OF THE ROCKIES (US-EIN:840772672); CATHOLIC HEALTH INITIATIVES COLORADO (US-EIN:840405257); YMCA OF THE ROCKIES (US-EIN:840404913); CHILDRENS HOSPITAL COLORADO (US-EIN:840166760); PORTERCARE ADVENTIST HEALTH SYSTEM (US-EIN:840438224).
bounty_if_no_wins.candidate_benefit_attestation: Issues immutable on-chain 'CONSTITUENT_MANDATE_VINDICATED' attestation for John W. Hickenlooper (US-CO) and credits the constituency's defense of the candidate for funding front-line state humanitarian & emergency infrastructure.
bounty_if_no_wins.destination_criteria: MUST be an IRS-audited 501(c)(3) public charity in US-CO operating in non-ideological universal commons (NTEE M24 Fire & Rescue, M20 Disaster Relief, W30 Veterans, K31 Food Banks, E20/E22 Community Hospitals, O Youth Development) with zero partisan lobbying, chosen only where both sides of the political divide benefit. Eligible commons beneficiaries: FOOD BANK OF THE ROCKIES (US-EIN:840772672); CATHOLIC HEALTH INITIATIVES COLORADO (US-EIN:840405257); YMCA OF THE ROCKIES (US-EIN:840404913); CHILDRENS HOSPITAL COLORADO (US-EIN:840166760); PORTERCARE ADVENTIST HEALTH SYSTEM (US-EIN:840438224).
